description: New /app/teams route + nav entry. Team list (player + opponent sections), create/rename/delete. Team editor with 6 slots; slot editor to pick species (search), ability, nature, EV spread (sliders with 510/252 caps + live stat preview), IV spread, and up to 4 moves from the species' legal learnset (from T-005). Opponent teams use the same editor with kind=opponent. Extend frontend/lib/api.ts + types.ts. Reuse TypeBadge/StatBars/sprite conventions. Entrance/scroll reveals via IntersectionObserver+CSS; GSAP reserved for stat-bar moments; respect prefers-reduced-motion.
title: Frontend: team builder UI (/teams) + slot editor
